svg.title: TYPE_READY_FOR_RETRIEVE -> ExpandReadyForRetrieveJob()
svg.desc: Prepare bay B21 for a future retrieve: switch it to retrieve mode and clear the tray inside. Unlike READY_FOR_INSERT, there is no final bay transition.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. A replay that fails fails the job. In this example: Empty DAG. (replay)", "Row 2. Only a bay in insert or retrieve mode can be prepared for retrieval. In this example: B21 is READY_TO_INSERT. (passes)", "Row 3. A bay in insert mode is switched to retrieve mode first. In this example: BayTransition TRANSITION_TO_RETRIEVE on the first system floor. (adds 1)", "Row 4. Check whether a tray sits in the bay. In this example: Empty tray T21 is inside. (found)", "Row 5. A car in the bay that asked for charging goes to a VECS. In this example: T21 has no payload. (skipped)", "Row 6. Any other tray is moved out of the bay, destination left for tray assignment. In this example: T21 leaves the bay; OrderAfterJobLeafEvents orders it after 1. (adds 2 \u00b7 1 -> 2)", "Row 7. Report success. No final transition: the bay stays in retrieve mode. In this example: The bay stays READY_TO_RETRIEVE. (success)", "Playing the plan (one illustrative execution: AGV assignment and motion planning choose the real AGV and route): event 1. B21 switches to READY_TO_RETRIEVE.", "Playing the plan: AGV-1 drives empty W26 -> W25 -> W22 -> W41 -> B21 and stops under T21 (the approach for event 2; AGV assignment adds such moves later).", "Playing the plan: event 2. AGV-1 lifts T21, carries it B21 -> W41 -> W22 -> P23 and lowers it. The destination P23 is illustrative: tray assignment fills the '?' later. Every tray and AGV is now where the plan leaves it."]
